name: Claude PR & Issue Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  pr-review:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'anthropics'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run Claude PR review
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          CLAUDE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python scripts/claude_pr_review.py \
            --pr-number ${{ github.event.number }} \
            --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --base ${{ github.base_ref }} \
            --head ${{ github.head_ref }}

  pr-review-command:
    if: github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '/review-pr') && github.event.comment.author_association == 'MEMBER'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run Claude PR review (interactive)
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          CLAUDE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python scripts/claude_pr_review.py \
            --pr-number ${{ github.event.issue.number }} \
            --repo ${{ github.repository }}

  pr-ci-review:
    if: github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '/review-pr-ci') && github.event.comment.author_association == 'MEMBER'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run Claude PR review (CI only)
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          CLAUDE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python scripts/claude_pr_review.py \
            --pr-number ${{ github.event.issue.number }} \
            --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --ci-only

  issue-review:
    if: github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '/review-issue') && github.event.comment.author_association == 'MEMBER'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository

      - name: Set up Python
